- 📫 [LinkedIn](#) · [Resume](#)

**Recent problem I solved:** wrote a Python tool to correlate ping logs across two hosts and prove an intermittent outage was upstream at the ISP gateway, not my own wiring or Wi-Fi. Full writeup in the pinned repo.
